messages:
Emma: Quick sync — NewCorp RFI: I uploaded a final draft of the capability matrix and the written answers. Need signoff on the matrix and confirmation on pricing + POC scope by EOD Friday. @Jon can you confirm the tiered pricing lines? @Samar can you confirm the SQA answers for HSM/KMS?

Jon: saw the draft, will review. Quick Q — are we including Dedicated capacity pricing in the RFI or just hosted + private?

Emma: include all three. NewCorp explicitly asked for on-prem and Dedicated breakouts. Add a short note that Dedicated pricing is estimate pending infra availability.

Samar: I pulled the security questionnaire. For HSM/Azure Key Vault we said "compatible via KMIP" — I updated to reference our KMS integrations (AWS KMS + customer HSM) and flagged the FedRAMP question as "under review by compliance". Will attach redlines.

Priya: tagging legal — we should avoid phrasing that implies FedRAMP cert. Use: "supports customer-managed keys and HSM-backed key storage through partner integrations."

Luis: on POC cost — suggested approach: 2-week functional POC on hosted + 1-week dedicated perf run. Estimate: `POC labor + infra = $12,000` flat fee (includes reserved GPU time). Does that align with pricing expectations?

Jon: $12k seems fine. For the matrix pricing columns, suggest adding a line for "burst capacity" cost and one for "support (SLA)" (Standard vs Enterprise). Also include a note: "actual Dedicated monthly commit TBD after infra sizing."

Emma: good call. I'm going to add a small footnote for burst pricing and SLA tiers.

deploy-bot: Build artifact uploaded: `newcorp_rfi_v3.pdf` (size: 1.4MB) — link: https://internal.s3/newcorp_rfi_v3.pdf

Samar: redlines attached. For the security Qs I left TODOs on 3 items: 1) encryption in transit specifics, 2) log retention options for Private, 3) KMS HSM attestation language. Compliance will deliver final language by Thurs COB.

Emma: perfect. Can someone do a quick run through the capability matrix table for accuracy? I want to avoid any conflicting rows vs the written answers.

Jon: I'll scrub the matrix for consistency (models listed, quantization support, streaming API). I'll also add a column "verified on demo" and check the boxes we tested.

Priya: Legal wants a one-sentence addition to the appendix: "Deployment & data residency specifics subject to signing of private deployment addendum."

Emma: ok — plan: Jon finalizes matrix by tomorrow morning, Samar finalizes security wording by Thursday, Luis confirms POC cost and we attach invoice template. I'll then bundle and send to NewCorp by Friday 3pm PT.

Luis: note on invoice template — use `POC-Standard-Template-v2.docx`. I'll update amounts and send to Emma for attachment.

Jon: done with first pass — changed the matrix row names slightly to avoid ambiguity between "Private" and "Dedicated". Also added quantization support matrix for 8-bit/4-bit.

Samar: compliance dropped a note: "We cannot commit to SOC2 Type II completion dates in RFI responses; suggest 'SOC2 compliance in scope' language." I updated that line.

Emma: thanks all. One blocker: NewCorp asks for a sample SLA for Dedicated — do we have a redacted SLA we can include? @Priya

Priya: Yes — use `SLA-Redacted-Dedicated-v1.pdf`. I'll attach a redacted copy and add a sentence we can negotiate uptime thresholds in contract.

Emma: excellent. If anything pops up, ping here. I'll post the final package link when ready. :thumbsup:

Luis: small ask — can we include a short performance appendix with token/latency numbers from our last Dedicated benchmark? Helps procurement.

Jon: I'll extract the 99th/median token latency numbers and add a one-page appendix.

Emma: great. Thanks team — target: Friday EOD.

Samar: noted. Compliance will aim to get the final HSM attestation line by Thursday midday.

deploy-bot: File packaged: `newcorp_rfi_final_package_2045679460.zip` — link: https://internal.s3/newcorp_rfi_final_package_2045679460.zip

Emma: package received. Sending to NewCorp now. Thread closed. :rocket:
